title: pack's passing and priced notes are not read by the kb: hook's false-good sentence, backlog.py's judge and ql_learn.passes
goal: kb_hook.routed adds its possible-false-good sentence, bl_check.py's judge reports partial and ql_learn.passes reports no pass for a good pack whose passing or priced note is set, as they do for unmatched and spread; judge and ql_learn.passes also treat a good pack with the scatter check: line (pack's scatter key) as flagged, since their docs say sufficient is a good pack with no check: line

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_hook;c=kb_hook.routed({'route':'split','verdict':'good','text':'coverage: good\ncheck: x','passing':['tempdb'],'priced':False});sys.exit(0 if 'flags a possible false good' in c else 1)
import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_check;s=bl_check.KnowledgeState(types.SimpleNamespace(root="."));r=s.judge("page file size");print(r);sys.exit(0 if r[0]=="partial" else 1)

import sys,types;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_check;base=dict(verdict="good",sources=[],paths=[],unmatched=[],spread=None,scatter=None,passing=[],priced=False);bad=[]
for k,v in (("passing",["tempdb"]),("priced",True)):
 s=bl_check.KnowledgeState(types.SimpleNamespace(root="."));r=dict(base,**dict([(k,v)]));s.pack=lambda q,r=r:r
 bad+=[k] if s.judge("x")[0]!="partial" else []
s=bl_check.KnowledgeState(types.SimpleNamespace(root="."));s.pack=lambda q:base
bad+=["clean"] if s.judge("x")[0]!="sufficient" else []
print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_learn;base=dict(verdict="good",paths=[],unmatched=[],spread=None,scatter=None,passing=[],priced=False);bad=[k for k,v in (("passing",["tempdb"]),("priced",True),("scatter",(9.0,["a","b"]))) if ql_learn.passes(dict(base,**dict([(k,v)])),None)]
bad+=[] if ql_learn.passes(base,None) else ["clean"]
print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes:
Merged from BG-cs4xmk74 at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: judge('page file size') returns ('sufficient','') for a good pack whose only check: line is the scatter note; same predicate (hook, judge and ql_learn.passes read only unmatched and spread). rag.scatter_calibration read on 2026-10-12: at threshold 15 the note flags 8 of 11 off-kb goods and 3 of 236 eval goods, so the scatter line counts as flagged (gate g1); scatter sets no route, so kb_hook.routed never sees it alone.
